name: Long Heavy-Duty  rubber Protective Gloves
description: Long heavy-duty protective gloves are designed to provide extended hand and forearm protection during cleaning, sanitation, waste handling, and other demanding tasks. Made for durability and practical use, they help protect against dirt, moisture, and contact with common cleaning solutions, depending on the glove material and chemical compatibility. Suitable for hospitals, healthcare facilities, cleaning companies, hotels, industrial workplaces, and institutional environments.
